data.notes: The report gets the central lessons right. The rep's 'clean' deal is shown to be contradicted twice, by the PayPal/Venmo dodge and the undelivered saved-card reference. The Braintree guess is labelled opinion, and the auth-rate silence and the CFO's payout-timing question both become messaging changes. Its main miss is leaving the incumbent null and listing it as an open question, when the three account-manager changes in two years show Braintree was the incumbent. It also reads the Braintree call itself as unconfirmed, though the rep states it happened. Its customer-language work omits 'the app' and sometimes falls back to 'sellers' instead of 'sitters'.
